scope: Cash acceptance: clause 22 lies in Chapter 2, paragraph 2, not a universal departure ban.

prerequisites.legal_date_applicable: Recording date and applicable legal edition have been established separately.
prerequisites.institution_in_scope: Institution, activity and jurisdiction fall within the cited provision.
prerequisites.acceptance: The transaction is cash acceptance, supported independently of departure.
prerequisites.service_ongoing: Client service has not finished at the departure boundary.
prerequisites.departure: The same role-grounded cashier leaves the established workstation.

visual_limits: A customer leaving does not satisfy the cashier predicate.
A disappearance behind occlusion is not a proven departure.
Role evidence must precede or accompany the movement and preserve continuity.

scope: Cash acceptance and counting in the client presence.

prerequisites.legal_date_applicable: Recording date and applicable legal edition have been established separately.
prerequisites.institution_in_scope: Institution, activity and jurisdiction fall within the cited provision.
prerequisites.client_absent: The client is demonstrably absent during the relevant activity, with full relevant scene visibility.

visual_limits: Offscreen or unsampled is not absent.
Do not transfer the duty to a different actor or transaction phase.

scope: Previously accepted cash storage during cash acceptance.

prerequisites.legal_date_applicable: Recording date and applicable legal edition have been established separately.
prerequisites.institution_in_scope: Institution, activity and jurisdiction fall within the cited provision.
prerequisites.prior_cash: The cash has been established as previously accepted, distinct from the current client cash.
prerequisites.storage_nonconformity: The visible storage arrangement fails the specified lockable-storage duty.

visual_limits: A visible pile alone does not establish ownership, prior acceptance or a lock failure.
Lockable and continuously locked are different claims; do not add a continuous-lock requirement without another source.

scope: Clause 19(2): acceptance counting; authenticity/payment fitness requires separate evidence.

prerequisites.legal_date_applicable: Recording date and applicable legal edition have been established separately.
prerequisites.institution_in_scope: Institution, activity and jurisdiction fall within the cited provision.
prerequisites.acceptance: Cash acceptance and actor roles are established.
prerequisites.complete_opportunity: Complete counting opportunity is visible at sufficient resolution.
prerequisites.count_omitted: Required banknote/coin counting is demonstrably omitted.

visual_limits: A few sampled images cannot establish an omitted count.
Do not claim counterfeit notes or authenticity-check failure from low-resolution CCTV.

scope: Clause 19(6): confirmation of completed cash acceptance.

prerequisites.legal_date_applicable: Recording date and applicable legal edition have been established separately.
prerequisites.institution_in_scope: Institution, activity and jurisdiction fall within the cited provision.
prerequisites.full_handoff_opportunity: Entire relevant document-issue opportunity is observed.
prerequisites.confirmation_not_issued: Confirmation was not issued; relevant alternative delivery/context has been checked.

visual_limits: An unreadable paper or offscreen/digital delivery does not establish non-issuance.
Do not infer document contents, signatures or accounting values without legible evidence.

scope: Clause 32: required banknote/coin counting method on payout, with packaging qualifications.

prerequisites.legal_date_applicable: Recording date and applicable legal edition have been established separately.
prerequisites.institution_in_scope: Institution, activity and jurisdiction fall within the cited provision.
prerequisites.payout: Cash payout is established separately from acceptance.
prerequisites.full_opportunity: Relevant counting opportunity is completely observed.
prerequisites.counting_method_omitted: Required leaf-by-leaf or coin-by-coin counting is demonstrably omitted for the relevant packaging condition.

exceptions.packaging_qualification: Clause 32 permits the relevant intact packaging/label-based method rather than leaf-by-leaf counting.

visual_limits: Distinguish intact packs, incomplete/damaged straps, and incomplete coin bags.
Do not call absence of leaf counting a violation when clause 32 permits the method.

scope: Clause 31(6): confirmation of completed cash payout.

prerequisites.legal_date_applicable: Recording date and applicable legal edition have been established separately.
prerequisites.institution_in_scope: Institution, activity and jurisdiction fall within the cited provision.
prerequisites.full_handoff_opportunity: Entire relevant document-issue opportunity is observed.
prerequisites.confirmation_not_issued: Confirmation was not issued; relevant alternative delivery/context has been checked.

visual_limits: Short sampling, an occluded handoff and unreadable documents cannot prove non-issuance.

scope: Counting, sorting and packaging in the presence of a controlling employee.

prerequisites.legal_date_applicable: Recording date and applicable legal edition have been established separately.
prerequisites.institution_in_scope: Institution, activity and jurisdiction fall within the cited provision.
prerequisites.processing: The activity is the covered cash counting, sorting or packaging operation.
prerequisites.controller_absent: Absence of the controlling employee is established with complete relevant visibility.

exceptions.client_acceptance_or_payout: The activity is client cash acceptance or payout, which clause 42 expressly excepts.

visual_limits: A lone cashier serving a client is not by itself a clause 42 violation.
Controller role cannot be inferred from simply seeing another person.

scope: Clause 24(3)-(4): bags accepted from a collection unit/organization.

prerequisites.legal_date_applicable: Recording date and applicable legal edition have been established separately.
prerequisites.institution_in_scope: Institution, activity and jurisdiction fall within the cited provision.
prerequisites.collection_handoff: Collection-unit/organization handoff is established, not an ordinary customer transaction.
prerequisites.full_check_opportunity: The relevant checking opportunity is completely visible.
prerequisites.bag_check_omitted: The specified bag integrity/seal check is demonstrably omitted.

visual_limits: Do not classify a bag-bearing customer as a collector from appearance.
Bag/seal condition may be unobservable at the supplied resolution.

scope: Foreign-exchange operating cash room; the institution and room type must be established.

prerequisites.legal_date_applicable: Recording date and applicable legal edition have been established separately.
prerequisites.institution_in_scope: Institution, activity and jurisdiction fall within the cited provision.
prerequisites.exchange_room: The room is an exchange operating cash room covered by clause 41.
prerequisites.unauthorized_person: The person is established to be an outsider, not merely unfamiliar in appearance.
prerequisites.entry: Their presence inside that room is observed.

visual_limits: Employee authorization is usually not visible in CCTV.
A bank teller window is not automatically a licensed exchange office.

scope: Clause 16(1) concerns a separate entrance and lockable door construction.

prerequisites.legal_date_applicable: Recording date and applicable legal edition have been established separately.
prerequisites.institution_in_scope: Institution, activity and jurisdiction fall within the cited provision.
prerequisites.cash_room: The relevant space is an in-scope cash room.
prerequisites.construction_nonconformity: A separate entrance with a lockable door is demonstrably lacking.

visual_limits: An open door does not prove the door is not lockable or must always be closed.
Construction, security performance and unavailable camera angles need non-video evidence.

scope: Clause 31(4): counting prepared payout cash in the client presence.

prerequisites.legal_date_applicable: Recording date and applicable legal edition have been established separately.
prerequisites.institution_in_scope: Institution, activity and jurisdiction fall within the cited provision.
prerequisites.payout: Cash payout is established separately from acceptance.
prerequisites.full_opportunity: Relevant counting opportunity is completely observed.
prerequisites.client_absent: The client is demonstrably absent during counting with full relevant visibility.

visual_limits: A permitted packaging-based counting method does not waive the client-presence requirement.
Offscreen or unsampled is not absent.
